title: Sharp Approximation on the Sphere by Linearized Shallow Networks with Analytic Activations
summary: We study the spectral behavior and approximation properties of linearized shallow networks with analytic activation functions on the unit sphere $\mathbb S^d$. Motivated by earlier spherical approximation results for analytic zonal functions \cite{mhaskar1999approximation}, we first derive an asymptotic formula, expressed explicitly in terms of the residues, for the ultraspherical coefficients of a real-analytic function whose relevant singularities are a conjugate pair of simple poles on the imaginary axis.
